name: @solx/tauri
description: Tauri IPC client for a solx desktop host (the solx Tauri plugin). Same manager surface as @solx/http, with invoke() in place of fetch.
//: Zero-dependency like @solx/http: the host injects Tauri's `invoke` (from @tauri-apps/api/core) into connectTauri, so this package never imports @tauri-apps/api itself. @solx/surface is a file: dep for the same reason @solx/http's is.
